TITLE ZIP_CMDS / FOR_CMDS fixture
DESCRIPTION Both grammar forms, marker composition, and literal angle brackets.

WILDCARD ?

ab<>
----

GOAL
b???

;; Implicit-CMD form: repeated and adjacent markers, mandatory side effect.
ZIP_CMDS step_<g><g> g ab G AB
 MATCH1
  G- -G mark_<g>_e!

  <? <?

;; Full-body form wrapping ROTATE_CMDS: template before orbit; the <>
;; cells in patterns stay literal board characters.
ZIP_CMDS g ab
 ROTATE_CMDS mark_<g> eswn
  ATOMIC
   g? g? [norotate]

   <> <>

;; FOR_CMDS nesting: outer-then-inner product order, names carry both.
FOR_CMDS outer_<x> x pq
 CALL_EACH inner_<x>_m inner_<x>_n

FOR_CMDS inner_p_<y> y mn
 ?? ??

FOR_CMDS inner_q_<y> y mn
 ?? ??

CMD _tick
 TRY_ALL
  CALL_EACH step_aa step_bb outer_p outer_q
